Global (All).title: Gun laws tightened in US following string of mass shootings
Global (All).summary: The US government has introduced stricter gun controls in response to recent mass shootings, including a plan to raise the minimum age to buy semi-automatic rifles from 18 to 21.

Global (All).title: French parliament passes bill to ban protests near Eiffel Tower
Global (All).summary: The French parliament has passed a bill that bans protests near the Eiffel Tower in a move to control demonstrations and maintain public order.

Global (All).title: Beijing warns against spreading "harmful rumors" about Xinjiang
Global (All).summary: The Chinese government has warned against spreading "harmful rumors" about Xinjiang, a region in western China, amid reports of human rights abuses and genocide.

United States.title: Violent Protests Break Out in California Over Police Shooting
United States.summary: Protests in California turned violent after a police shooting, with demonstrators throwing rocks and bottles at officers. The protests were sparked by the death of a 26-year-old man who was shot by police in Los Angeles.

United States.title: New Cyberattack Targets US Government Agencies
United States.summary: A new cyberattack has targeted US government agencies, with reports of sensitive data being stolen. The attack is believed to be linked to a group of hackers who have been targeting government agencies in recent months.

United States.title: Supreme Court Weighs in on Gun Control Laws
United States.summary: The Supreme Court is set to weigh in on gun control laws after a federal appeals court ruled that a New York law restricting concealed carry permits is unconstitutional. The ruling could have major implications for gun control laws across the country.

South Korea.title: North Korea's Kim sends message to ally in South Korea's presidential election
South Korea.summary: SEOUL (Reuters) - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un sent a message to his South Korean counterpart, Yoon Suk Yeol, congratulating him on his presidential election victory, a South Korean official said on Thursday. The message, carried by state news agency KCNA, was the first time Kim has publicly congratulated a South Korean leader on their election.

South Korea.title: Seoul: North Korea fires short-range ballistic missile, third this week
South Korea.summary: SEOUL, South Korea (AP) — North Korea fired a short-range ballistic missile into the sea on Wednesday, the third launch this week, South Korean officials said.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires 2nd ballistic missile in 24 hours as South Korea conducts live-fire drills
South Korea.summary: SEOUL, South Korea (AP) — North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea on Thursday, the second this week, South Korean officials said, a day after the North test-launched a hypersonic missile that Seoul said was likely intended to be a nuclear-capable weapon.

Japan.title: Japan warns of potential cyber attacks by North Korea
Japan.summary: Japan has warned of potential cyber attacks by North Korea, amid rising tensions between the countries.

Japan.title: Japanese government faces backlash over COVID-19 response
Japan.summary: The Japanese government has faced criticism for its handling of the COVID-19 pandemic, with many citizens feeling that the measures put in place were not effective enough.

Japan.title: Rising tensions between Japan and China over disputed islands
Japan.summary: Tensions have been rising between Japan and China over a disputed group of islands in the East China Sea, with both countries accusing each other of increasing military activity in the area.
